text: The leak-rate lab describes α as a 'temporal zoom lens.' What is the recommended way to choose it?
choices: Match α so the effective time constant τ_eff ≈ the task's timescale
Always set α = 1 regardless of the task
Set α as small as possible to maximize memory
Set α equal to the spectral radius ρ
explanation: leak_rate_effect.py and Section 8.4 recommend matching τ_eff = 1/(α(1−ρ)) to the task timescale (α* ≈ 1/(T_0(1−ρ))). Very small α over-smooths and misses fast fluctuations; α=1 is only the maximally-responsive default, not always optimal.
